# Cart — Experience Spine

## Foundation

Responsive web, phone first. `DESIGN.md` is the visual identity reference.

## Information Architecture

| Surface | Reached from | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| Product page | Catalogue | Add to cart |
| Cart | Header cart icon | Lines, quantities, total |

## UJ-1 — Mia fills her cart on the bus

1. On a product page Mia taps **Add to cart**; the header count goes up.
2. In the cart she raises the mugs to three with the stepper.
3. **Climax:** the total, in `{colors.total}`, updates before her thumb lifts.
